_atribucion: BFI-2 © Oliver P. John and Christopher J. Soto. Spanish adaptation by Gallardo-Pujol et al. (2022).

papeles.Soto & John, 2017: The instrument: the 60 items, the five domains and their fifteen facets.
papeles.Gallardo-Pujol y cols., 2022: The official Spanish adaptation of the BFI-2 — the version behind Identify's Spanish edition — and the reliabilities that force caution about what is claimed from a single facet.
papeles.Danner & Lechner, 2024: What the facets predict at work: satisfaction, turnover, organizational citizenship behavior, burnout risk and engagement.
papeles.Ozer & Benet-Martínez, 2006: The review that lays out which life outcomes are associated with each trait, and how strongly.
papeles.Soto, 2019: The replication that says which of those associations hold up and how much they shrink when repeated. It is the reason this report speaks conditionally.
